decision.scope: The Kani verification lane's equation shape under catherine-6g2, partitioned per family (Decision 4 at walker and dispatch granularity): the check side's per-family walk entries (engine_dangling_findings / engine_equation_findings, lane-only), the soundness dispatch split per witness kind, the new declared check_dangling_panic_freedom harness (16 declared), and the findings arena — the partition entries emit into Bounded tables through the FindingSink sink (slot writes + sort_pushed_by) instead of the findings heap Vec, slice insertion sort, and symbolic slice iteration. Measured under the 8 GB / 300 s standard.
decision.rationale: The lane extends: the recorded partition trigger (ledger 0007 hole 2) was executed and the dangling family now verifies at the standard in both halves — the lane's 5th and 6th proofs and the first walker-family and witness-soundness results. The round's measurement shaped the fix: the Vec-backed partitions budget-killed all four harnesses, with check_dangling dying in the SOLVE phase at 3 156 post-slicing VCCs (the reduction completed) — formula size was no longer the axis. The findings arena removed the last heap/slice machinery from the walk surface, and check_dangling then PROVED with more VCCs (4 837) than it died with (3 156) at 3:30 wall / 4.96 GB peak (symex 83.7 s, solver 0.58 s), soundness_dangling at 3:59 / 5.92 GB (symex 85.7 s, solver 1.29 s). The proved pairs run at ~5-6 GB peak inside the scope: the solve loop's memory genuinely grows per property, and harness death tracks that growth (property count and per-property instance mass), not raw VCC count. The equation partitions remain solve-phase-walled — check_equation (symex 85.7 s, 8 545 VCCs after slicing) and soundness_equation (symex 99.8 s, 18 097 VCCs) budget-killed in the solver — and the --slice-formula probe on check_equation was negative (identical post-slicing VCCs, no verdict, killed at the cap), extending the 0004 solver-tuning retirement to this wall class as measured. Contract suite (633 tests), clippy -D warnings, fmt, and ledger-check all green; the four proved build harnesses are untouched; the parsed surface is byte-identical.
holes_found: the equation walk's solve-phase wall stands at 8 545 (check) and 18 097 (soundness) post-slicing VCCs; the recorded trigger: a Kani/CBMC release whose per-property solve loop stops growing memory per property — re-probe check_equation_panic_freedom first — or a further property-count reduction on the equation walk's formula; the --slice-formula probe is measured negative

the six other undetermined harnesses (key, coproduct, pullback check and soundness families, the all-families walk, the all-families build) were not re-run this round; their recorded path is the same partition-plus-arena pattern, funded separately
decision.fixture_only_comparison: The fixture corpus and the contract suite pin the parsed surface byte-identically — engine_families keeps its Vec signature for the parsed flavor (the FindingSink Vec arm is the asserted-append it already used), and only the lane-only partition entries changed shape. Cost: one four-harness undetermined round (Vec partitions), one four-harness round (two proofs, two solve-phase kills), one negative slice-formula probe.
